item.description:
# RunHuddle 0.14.0
- Simplified session navigation to Now, Pinned, All sessions, and Archived. Saved work lives in its own Library section with independent tool/project filters. - Search defaults to the current view, matching filter behavior. Search all sessions explicitly includes archived sessions while keeping tool/project selections. - Replaced nested filter menus with a popover containing direct tool choices and a searchable project list. - Grouped inactive history and unconfirmed live connections under Previous session, with uncertainty explained only in details. - Filtered empty states explain missing matches and offer Clear filters or View matching history.
Validation: full release suite, native build, standalone packaging and updater checks. Live UI interaction is not automatically tested.
